name: r032.fresh_camp_establishment_v001_mcw
description: R-032 fresh establishment and assignment route: a disposable current-source pre-camp world has one setup-only nearby unassigned follower, then the player follows only advertised native semantic dialogue and menu owners to establish a camp on the eligible site, assign that same follower through the native camp-assignment UI at the camp OMT, and preserve the assignment through native save, quit, process replacement, and ordinary camp-work continuation.  Fixture setup and selector opening have no outcome credit.

steps.label: establish_r032_camp
steps.objective: Use only currently advertised native semantic actions to select the setup-only nearby follower, establish a camp, position that follower at the resulting camp's actual lookup OMT, and use the native assignment UI.  Verify the identical character ID changes from unassigned to CAMP_RESIDENT with assigned_camp exactly matching the new camp; make at least one ordinary camp job priority usable before native save and quit.
proof_targets: fixture-derived follower identity and no assigned camp, recorded as setup only
accepted native World, dialogue, and menu receipts for the chosen establishment route
resulting authoritative camp identity, owner, and actual lookup OMT
same follower character ID before/after native assignment, CAMP_RESIDENT mission, matching assigned_camp, and usable job priorities
independent native postcondition observation after native assignment
invariants: fixture installation and its added follower are setup only and receive zero establishment credit
do not use physical controls, OCR, coordinates, source inference, direct NPC/camp/save mutation, or synthetic receipt injection
camp selector availability or selection alone does not prove establishment
a passing assignment verdict requires a same-run authoritative resulting camp identity, its actual lookup OMT, and the same actual assigned actor
creation and assignment are distinct: do not infer assignment from camp creation, follower placement, or selector reachability
leave missions, Food, Storage, Locker, and Patrol as separate R-032 verdicts
stop the affected claim at missing native receipt, source-binding drift, stale owner, or cleanup failure while retaining independent evidence

steps.label: verify_r032_assigned_camp_continuity
steps.objective: After the native save, main-menu quit, and process replacement, use only currently advertised native semantic actions to inspect the same follower character ID.  Verify CAMP_RESIDENT and assigned_camp still match the saved camp's actual OMT, then reopen ordinary camp work and confirm the job-priority controls remain usable without reassigning or restaging the fixture.
proof_targets: native save/quit boundary and process replacement
same follower character ID after reload
persisted CAMP_RESIDENT mission and assigned_camp matching the same camp OMT
ordinary post-reload camp-work/job-priority controls usable without a new assignment
invariants: relaunch is lifecycle evidence, not assignment credit
do not restage the fixture or create/assign a replacement follower
do not mutate NPC, camp, or save state directly
missing identity, camp match, resident mission, priority usability, or native save/quit receipt leaves continuity unproved
